summary.text: Christopher (Chris) Reichard is the Democratic nominee for Missouri's 8th District.
An Army veteran who served three tours in Iraq, he became a union electrician with IBEW Local 1 after working in non-union telecommunications construction.
He is campaigning on strengthening organized labor and restoring cut federal programs.

paragraphs.text: Reichard was born in Tennessee and raised in the greater St. Louis region, according to his Ballotpedia survey and profile.
He joined the workforce at 16 and graduated from Northwest High School.
He told KRCU that he joined the Army after graduating high school in 2003.
Ballotpedia lists his Army service as 2004 to 2012, including three tours in Iraq.

After leaving the Army, Reichard worked in non-union telecommunications construction in Houston, Texas, before returning home to Missouri, where he grew up, and joining IBEW Local 1 as a union electrician.
KRCU describes him as a communications journeyman technician, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as communications specialist.
He won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary with 54.1% of the vote over Frank Barnitz, which is the first run for office Ballotpedia lists for him.
